name: Pull-up

phases.name: pull
phases.cue: Pull your elbows down to your sides

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower slowly to a dead hang

formTips: Grip the bar overhand, a little wider than your shoulders
Start from a dead hang with your arms long and shoulders pulled down
Drive your elbows down towards your ribs until your chin clears the bar
Lower slowly all the way back to straight arms
For an assisted pull-up, loop a band under your feet or knees, or use the assisted machine, and keep the same form
commonMistakes: Kicking or swinging the legs to get up
Stopping halfway instead of returning to straight arms
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears
Reaching the chin up instead of pulling the body up
